title: Requirement
description: A structured statement of what needs to be built, why, who it serves, and what done means.

statement.description: What needs to be built, in one sentence

stakeholder.description: Who this serves — a role or persona, not a name

why.description: The underlying need or pain point being addressed

done_when.description: Testable conditions that define completion. Each item must be verifiable from the outside.

out_of_scope.description: Explicitly excluded from this requirement to prevent scope creep

linked_issues.description: Issue URLs or IDs this requirement traces to (GitHub, Linear, Jira)

reasoning.description: Agent scratchpad — chain-of-thought during capture. Not consumed downstream.
